section: Verify Operational NAT Rules / Verify Routing / Verify Security Policy
content:
# Verify Operational NAT Rules / Verify Routing / Verify Security Policy

Run:

show security nat source rule all

Verify that:

- Rule set is active
- Source match is correct
- Translation pool is correct

---

Run:

show route 0.0.0.0/0

Also verify the path to any specific test destination.

---

Run:

show security policies

Verify:

trust -> untrust

is permitted.

---
